headline: MIN @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.55 at DET 3.95, with a projected total of 7.50. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: MIN moved -0.28 runs while DET moved -0.12, changing the projected margin by -0.17 runs. The projected total fell -0.40, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +7.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Troy Melton has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.3 ER over the last 3 outings. Batter research is strongest for Kevin McGonigle, Josh Bell, Riley Greene, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
